analyses.content: 录音中的“Where the highway begins”对应题干的“starting point”，顺着“must stop”往后听就能抓到停下来的目的是为了“registration”。
你可能会听到句末的“emergency”并把它作为答案，但语义上“为了紧急情况而停下来”在这里是不通顺的。
Where the highway begins, there is a roadside office where you must stop. The road is remote, so your registration is very important in case of an emergency.
录音里的“For additional safety”和“along the highway”完美对应题干的“For safety reasons”和“on the highway”，中间提到的安装物就是“telephones”。
你可能会往后听到“staff”或“office”产生动摇，但注意题目问的是公路上有什么，只有电话是被安装在公路沿线的。
For additional safety, at different places along the highway, telephones have been installed which connect with staff in the office. Remember, there is no mobile service in this remote area.
题干的“works with other institutes”对应录音的“works with various universities”，“research”被替换成了“carry out studies into”，紧跟其后的研究对象就是“ecology”。
你可能只听到了“studies”就想填，但题干已经有“research”这个动作了，空里缺的是被研究的具体领域。
You will stay at Radisson Research Center, which works with various universities and Hydro-Quebec to carry out studies into the ecology of the region.
题干中的“the effect of... on the land”在录音中被替换成了“disturbance to the land caused by...”，由“by”引出的源头就是“insects”。
你可能会因为听到“disturbance”而误填，但题目问的是对土地产生影响的“施加者”，而不是影响现象本身。
Your first few days at the center will be spent attending lectures about their past research. You will hear that they have paid particular attention to any disturbance to the land caused by insects.
听到“outpost stations”定位，录音里的“varying patterns of”完美替换了题目的“variations in”，后面紧跟的核心词就是“climate”。
你可能会听到“patterns”或者“data”就急着写下来，但仔细看题目，问的是“什么东西的”变化，也就是气候本身。

After that, you will visit the various outpost stations. There are three of them, and when you visit them, you'll be able to observe how data on the varying patterns of the climate is collected and published for scientific research.
录音直接说出了题干的“breakdown is serious”，随后用“costly”同义替换了“expensive”，对应的主语就是“repairs”。
你可能会听到前一句的“damage”觉得很搭，但填进去变成“car damage are expensive”不仅语法单复数不对，也错过了后面真正的考点词。
Hydro-Quebec cautions that driving over rocks on the rough road may cause severe damage to the car. Any breakdown is serious as repairs are costly.
题干的“not many types of”在录音中被反向替换表达为“relatively poor in the number of”，后面直接跟出了“plant species”，结合 ONE WORD ONLY 的字数限制填“plant”。
你可能会听到“species”就填进去，但填“types of species”语义就重复了，题目缺的是具体的生物类别。
You will find the region is relatively poor in the number of plant species, yet there is a great variety of wildlife that can be seen.
录音里的“not safe”对应题干的“dangerous”，“not easily seen”对应了“hidden”，被隐藏起来的危险事物就是“pools”。
你可能会因为听到句末强调的“rocks”而分心，但石头是建议你走的“安全区域”，并不是隐藏的危险。
These low-lying areas are called muskeg, which is made up of slowly decomposing plants. It is not safe to walk on it, as it has pools that are not easily seen, so keep to the rocks.
录音前一句的“take plenty of pictures”对应了题干的“Photographs”，紧接着用“Then we will have...”引出了拍照的目的，即留作“documentation”。
你可能会试图把听到的“pictures”或“cameras”填进去，但这俩词只是拍照动作本身，题目缺的是拍照留存到未来的“目的”。

In fact, there are at least sixty varieties, so keep your waterproof digital cameras handy so you can take plenty of pictures. Then we will have documentation of the existing waterfowl as some are becoming extinct.
听到“Water”定位，录音里的“monitored for”是题干“checked for”的精准同义替换，后面跟着的就是答案“pollution”。
你可能会在前一句听到“analysis”就填上了，但仔细听下一句才知道，具体被检测化验的目标指标其实是污染。

Water is a problem in this area, so you'll also be collecting test tubes of water to bring back to our research lab for analysis. It needs to be monitored for pollution that may be caused by rainfall coming from the south.
